pr_title: drivers: usb: Fix NXP driver for CDC test cases
pr_body:
The cdc_acm tests were failing. Remove a length check in the write function as this is handled by the HAL driver. Remove unused type member and improve the error checking.

Fixes #53636 , #52625
pr_comments:
> Please split it in three commits, one for cleanup and error checking, second for the changes in usb_dc_ep_read_wait, and another for the changes in usb_dc_ep_write() to fix control IN transfers on IP3511.

PR split into 3 commits. I have tested this PR for both the EHCI (RT1060) and IP3511 (LPC55S69) controllers
@jfischer-no @desowin , can you take a look again.

issue_context.title: cdc_acm fails on lpcxpresso55s69 board
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Running the cdc_acm sample on this board fails.  

**To Reproduce**
Tested with this build command
```
west build -b lpcxpresso55s69_cpu0 samples/subsys/usb/cdc_acm
```

**Logs and console output**
With the latest main branch, the USB device does not enumerate properly in Windows.  The debug console shows no error:
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.2.0-3235-g871d6d26eeb0 ***
[00:00:00.000,000] <inf> cdc_acm_echo: Wait for DTR
```

Using v3.2.0, the USB device enumerates, but gives this error:
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.2.0  ***
[00:00:00.004,000] <inf> cdc_acm_echo: Wait for DTR
[00:00:07.560,000] <err> usb_dc_mcux: Failed to fill ep 0x80 buffer
```

Testing in v3.1, the app crashes with a hard fault:
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.1.0  ***
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: ***** HARD FAULT *****
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os:   Bus fault on vector table read
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: r0/a1:  0xfefa125b  r1/a2:  0x2280ff63  r2/a3:  0x4
0000000
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: r3/a4:  0x300007b0 r12/ip:  0x300007b0 r14/lr:  0x3
00039b0
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os:  xpsr:  0xc33cc200
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0x5ac3c35a
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 0: CPU exception on CPU 0
[00:00:00.004,000] <err> os: Current thread: 0x30000cc8 (unknown)
[00:00:00.061,000] <err> os: Halting system
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - tested on Windows10
 - Toolchain Zephyr SDK 0.15.1
comments: I recently ran into issues on `main` getting a `frdm_k64f` to enumerate on certain Windows USB hosts as well (Dell workstation + Windows 10 failed, Lenovo Laptop + Windows 10 works). Did you test on multiple hosts?

> I recently ran into issues on `main` getting a `frdm_k64f` to enumerate on certain Windows USB hosts as well (Dell workstation + Windows 10 failed, Lenovo Laptop + Windows 10 works). Did you test on multiple hosts?

Thanks @henrikbrixandersen , no I only tested on 1 Windows 10 machine, also a Dell

I've looked further into this issue, and the usb_dc_mcux driver doesn't support the 512 byte buffer of USB_HS. It sets it as 64, and then it fails to send the configuration descriptor as that is greater than 64 bytes. I don't know how to fix this though.

review_comments:
This intermediate buffer is not needed anymore. 
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/e7443bb2035574ec1377b791032769e3d0a7f428/drivers/usb/device/usb_dc_mcux.c#L281
Should it still be allocated?
This is used for the receive.
It is allocated for both IN and OUT endpoints, but with this changes the driver does not need to allocate it for the IN endpoints.
Thanks for pointing this, I have added a conditional check to only allocate for the OUT endpoints.
